task: optimizer convergence speed on a fixed synthetic task

paper.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
paper.authors: Diederik P. Kingma and Jimmy Ba

hypothesis: At a matched epoch budget, and with each optimizer family tuned by the same coarse learning-rate sweep, Adam reaches a training-loss target close to the converged floor in as few epochs as SGD, SGD with momentum, AdaGrad and RMSProp — and disabling Adam's bias correction changes when the target is reached.
